title: How a Godly Man Uses His Brothers Before He Needs Rescuing
caption:
Ecclesiastes 4:9-10 says two are better than one, because when one falls, the other lifts him up. He means before the fall, not just after.

Text the pull before you act on it. Let a friend see the calendar, not just the highlight reel. Ask before you assume you're fine.

You'll know a man is planted in real men when he shows up at the hospital, the move, the bad week, before anyone asks him to.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #community
